hypothesis: Preserve the best oracle return observed below every visited prefix and replace mean-only UCT exploitation with a fixed equal mixture of that prefix's maximum and average downstream return, so a rare exceptional completion continues to attract bounded search pressure instead of being erased by later mediocre siblings.
method_name: ChemTS-style RNN-guided Monte Carlo tree search
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic recurrent next-token model on the allowed unlabeled SMILES corpus and freeze it as a chemical-language prior. For each independent objective session, grow a fresh Monte Carlo search tree whose nodes are SMILES prefixes: initialize available path statistics from the ten scored starting molecules, select prefixes by an upper-confidence tree rule, expand them with high-probability unseen tokens from the frozen model, and use model rollouts to complete new molecules. Canonicalize locally and submit batches containing only newly constructed, valid, unique terminal SMILES; after each oracle response, backpropagate the observed scores through the visited prefix paths. The dynamically expanded tree therefore converts 290 feedback calls into increasingly focused de novo construction toward high terminal rewards without updating a policy, fitting a latent surrogate, mutating evaluated parent graphs, or ranking a finite corpus pool.

method_tags.acquisition_mechanism: UCT exploration-exploitation scores over a dynamically expanded prefix tree
method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline next-token model training plus online backpropagation of observed rewards into prefix visit counts and values
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: upper-confidence prefix selection, prior-guided token expansion, and recurrent rollouts to de novo terminal SMILES
method_tags.representation: tokenized SMILES prefixes with a frozen recurrent chemical-language prior

activation_observables.measurement: For every accepted scored proposal, audit that each node on its recorded backpropagation path changes maximum downstream return from its previous value to max(previous maximum, observed score). For every later competitive UCT decision with at least two visited eligible children, record each child's visits, mean return, maximum return, mixed exploitation value, shared exploration and penalty terms, shared jitter, live argmax, and exact mean-only Parent-counterfactual argmax. Report maximum-return backup coverage, the mean positive exploitation lift 0.5 * (maximum - mean), the number of decisions with non-tied mixed-versus-mean scores, and the fraction at which the live choice differs from the Parent counterfactual in favor of a child with a higher maximum return. Parent n-90b1d8983033 has no maximum-return statistic, zero configured best-return lift, and zero such choice displacement; activation requires backup coverage 1.0 and a positive displacement rate once a non-tied opportunity exists.

applicability_conditions: Objective rewards must be stationary enough that an observed high return is evidence about a prefix's productive descendants rather than transient noise; maximum-sensitive exploitation can overcommit to noisy outliers.

Useful high-scoring completions must share a still-expandable token prefix with additional reachable molecules, so revisiting that prefix can expose new candidates rather than only an exhausted terminal or a permanently closed invalid leaf.

At least one visited competitive branch must have heterogeneous downstream returns, making its maximum exceed its mean and creating a mixed-versus-mean selection opportunity; the change has no behavioral effect when all child returns are tied or every child is visited only once.

Prefix identity must retain enough chemical locality for an exceptional SMILES completion to inform sibling rollouts; representation aliasing or objectives whose useful chemistry lies on unrelated low-prior prefixes can defeat the mechanism.

The inherited failed-leaf closure must continue to leave enough alternative expandable support to fill every announced batch within the fixed local guard; this intent does not change duplicate handling, tree exhaustion behavior, or any fallback.
Evidence is limited to seed 0: the repaired Parent has no three-seed reliability estimate, so stability of best-return pressure across the independent search seeds remains unestablished.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if any accepted finite oracle score fails to update the stored maximum on every node of its existing trace, if a logged mixed exploitation value or live argmax cannot be reconstructed exactly from the registered 0.5 maximum/0.5 mean formula and the unchanged UCT terms, or if the live choice never differs from the exact mean-only Parent counterfactual despite at least one competitive decision where the two formulas have non-tied argmaxes. A lower benchmark score after complete maximum backup and positive best-return-driven choice displacement would mean the mechanism activated but its exceptional-return pressure was not useful.
research_intent.implementation_change: Add one maximum-downstream-return statistic to TreeNode and update it, together with the unchanged visit count and return sum, on every node of each existing accepted-proposal backpropagation path. In _select_child, use 0.5 * mean_return + 0.5 * maximum_return as the empirical exploitation value for each visited child, and use the corresponding mixed parent value for the existing unvisited-child fallback; retain the current exploration bonus, recurrent-prior scaling, progressive widening, invalid and pending penalties, jitter draw, dead-leaf closure, expansion, rollout, canonicalization, novelty filters, valid fallbacks, prepared model, RNG seeding, and protocol unchanged. At each competitive selection, reuse the same candidate set, penalties, exploration terms, and jitter values to log the exact mean-only Parent counterfactual beside the live mixed-value choice; diagnostics must not consume RNG or affect selection.
research_intent.mechanism: Preserve the best oracle return observed below every visited prefix and replace mean-only UCT exploitation with a fixed equal mixture of that prefix's maximum and average downstream return, so a rare exceptional completion continues to attract bounded search pressure instead of being erased by later mediocre siblings.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-90b1d8983033 repaired batch completion but deliberately retained n-ad8b380d9b4e's mean-only reward backup and UCT exploitation. On that inherited search, the observed selected-prefix mean-reward advantage was only 0.0006329631895537376 on deco_hop, 0.005031861523035976 on median_2, and 0.001232419284850641 on sitagliptin_mpo; after the repair enabled full seed-0 sessions, n-90b1d8983033 still finished those objectives at Top-1 values 0.5740228977497039, 0.1848376184037789, and 0.22309417065149867. The limiting behavior is that a prefix's rare exceptional completion loses influence as mediocre downstream returns accumulate in its empirical mean, even though this benchmark rewards the single best terminal molecule.

applicability_conditions: Operational activation is now supported across all three Search Seeds and all 15 task-seed sessions under the frozen 300-call, batch-10 profile: all 4,350 accepted adaptive proposals have complete maximum backup, all 191,631 logged child records reconstruct exactly, and each seed and task has positive strict higher-maximum displacement.

The required return-heterogeneity condition held broadly: 27,022/28,293 eligible decisions had non-tied mixed-versus-mean exploitation, all five tasks retained positive displacement and positive lift across the added replicas, and the three-seed pooled strict displacement rate is 0.4941858410207472.

The mechanism is robust across the three independently prepared frozen recurrent priors observed here. Every objective session loads its seed-specific prior, reports zero parameter drift and an identical load/shutdown hash, and initializes all ten scored starting paths with a root maximum equal to initial Top-1.

The inherited failed-leaf closure retained ample expandable support under every replicated trajectory. All 435 announced adaptive batches returned ten molecules from 9,305 raw local rollouts; the largest batch used 103 of the fixed 2,500-rollout guard despite 3,076 canonical-invalid terminals, 1,872 incomplete rollouts, six evaluated-molecule collisions, and one within-batch collision.

Direct algorithmic-Parent telemetry is available only for seed 0. Seeds 1 and 2 replicate the mechanism against the exact structural zero reference of a mean-only Parent, but they do not supply paired Parent score trajectories or establish a cross-seed causal score effect.

Transfer remains unestablished when rewards are noisy or nonstationary, all child returns are tied or observed once, a high-return prefix is exhausted or has no useful reachable siblings, prefix identity lacks chemical locality, or a weaker prior and novelty filter exhaust the bounded rollout guard.

observable_measurements.name: best_return_sensitive_uct_choice_rate
observable_measurements.parent_value: Before replication, this node's seed-0 record already had complete maximum-return backup for 1,450/1,450 proposals through 8,224 prefix nodes and 10,029 exactly reconstructible eligible decisions. Of those decisions, 9,596 had a non-tied mixed-versus-mean formula, 5,273 changed argmax, and 4,954 were strict higher-maximum displacements, giving choice rate 0.4939674942666268; 45,877 positive lift terms had mean 0.05148269800496388. The node's algorithmic Parent n-90b1d8983033 has no maximum-return state or best-return weight: TreeNode stores only visits and value_sum, backpropagation updates only those values, and selection uses mean plus the inherited exploration, penalties, and jitter. Its five seed-0 logs contain zero best_return_backup_audit or best_return_uct_decision events, so its configured maximum-sensitive exploitation lift and strict choice-displacement reference are exactly 0.0. The two new seeds reproduce the established positive direction rather than relying on seed 0 alone.
observable_measurements.value: Replication seeds 1 and 2 contributed ten complete task sessions and independently reproduced both registered parts of the mechanism. All 290 adaptive observe rounds emitted ten best_return_backup_audit records and a coverage receipt: 2,900/2,900 accepted finite scored proposals were completely backed up through all 15,902 recorded prefix nodes, for maximum-return backup coverage 1.0. Every audit matches the corresponding optimizer trajectory identity and score in order. Independent reconstruction found zero errors in visits_after = visits_before + 1, value_sum_after = value_sum_before + score, or maximum_return_after = max(maximum_return_before, score); all ten initial observations in each session were also seeded through the common backup, and every initialized root maximum equals the task's initial Top-1. The later searches logged 18,264 best_return_uct_decision events, exactly matching all per-round eligible-decision counters, and retained 126,375 child records. Recomputing maximum_return_used, the fixed 0.5 * mean_return + 0.5 * maximum_return_used exploitation value, both full UCT scores with identical exploration, penalties, and jitter, both argmaxes and prefixes, and all three event flags produced zero discrepancies. Of the 18,264 eligible decisions, 17,426 had a non-tied mixed-versus-mean formula, 9,624 changed argmax, and 9,028 changed the live choice in favor of a visited child with a strictly higher maximum return. The new-replica best-return-sensitive choice rate is therefore 9,028/18,264 = 0.49430573806395095; it is independently positive on seed 1 at 4,930/9,862 = 0.4998986006895153 and seed 2 at 4,098/8,402 = 0.48774101404427517. New-replica task counts and rates are deco_hop 899/2,706 = 0.33222468588322246, drd2_docking 2,822/4,255 = 0.663219741480611, median_2 1,054/3,162 = 0.3333333333333333, sitagliptin_mpo 1,974/4,229 = 0.46677701584298886, and zaleplon_mpo 2,279/3,912 = 0.5825664621676891. Across 90,406 positive visited-child lift terms, mean 0.5 * (maximum - mean) is 0.03997409263278518; task means in the same order are 0.01349537929450896, 0.06640484926246391, 0.019218816480150388, 0.022758208631305597, and 0.06406085308882735. Pooling the replicas with seed 0 gives complete maximum backup for 4,350/4,350 proposals through 24,126 prefix nodes and 28,293 exactly reconstructible eligible decisions with 27,022 non-tied opportunities, 14,897 argmax disagreements, and 13,982 strict higher-maximum displacements, for choice rate 0.4941858410207472; the pooled mean of 136,283 positive lift terms is 0.043848238994836475. The predicted increase from the algorithmic Parent's registered zero baseline therefore replicated on both added Search Seeds and all five objectives.

possible_failure_causes: Of 9,624 mixed-versus-mean argmax disagreements on the two added seeds, 9,028 met the strict registered criterion that both choices were visited and the live choice had the higher stored maximum; 596 did not. Across all three seeds the corresponding gap is 915 of 14,897 disagreements. The mixed parent fallback for unvisited children can therefore change some choices without direct evidence that the selected visited branch has a better observed maximum, so not every trajectory displacement is attributable to exceptional-return revisitation.

Best-return pressure is reproducible but objective-dependent. On the two new replicas, strict displacement rates range from 0.33222468588322246 on deco_hop to 0.663219741480611 on drd2_docking, while mean positive lift ranges from 0.01349537929450896 to 0.06640484926246391. Prefix-return heterogeneity and the influence of the persistent maximum therefore vary substantially with the objective and search trajectory even though every task activates.

The maximum statistic is permanently non-decaying. These deterministic benchmark replicas do not test noisy or nonstationary rewards, where one anomalous high score could retain excessive influence, nor do the receipts prove that a displaced high-maximum prefix still has chemically local productive siblings rather than an exhausted exceptional completion.

Similar activation rates do not imply uniform downstream utility: the three trusted seed macro scores are 0.48201782254225, 0.476750386216368, and 0.460400015814101 despite strict displacement rates clustered near one half. The three runs also use independently prepared recurrent priors. Without paired algorithmic-Parent runs for seeds 1 and 2, score variation cannot be causally assigned to best-return pressure, and activation alone does not establish that every retained maximum improves terminal Top-1.

applicability_conditions: The registered heterogeneity condition held broadly: 9,596 of 10,029 competitive decisions with at least two visited eligible children had a non-tied mixed-versus-mean exploitation value, every task produced positive lift terms and positive higher-maximum displacement, and the aggregate mean positive lift was 0.05148269800496388.

The inherited failed-leaf closure retained enough expandable support under the changed selection trajectory. All 145 announced adaptive batches returned 10 molecules; the five tasks used 3,255 raw local rollouts in total, and the largest single batch used 57, far below the fixed 2,500-rollout guard, despite 1,086 canonical-invalid terminals and 718 incomplete rollouts.

The isolation assumptions held for the formal replica: Candidate and Parent used identical prepared-artifact content, each Candidate task reported zero frozen-prior parameter drift and matching load/shutdown hashes, and the source diff leaves expansion, rollout, canonicalization, novelty filters, penalties, dead-leaf closure, and RNG draws unchanged apart from reusing already drawn jitters in diagnostics.

On this replica, the utility condition held in aggregate: the trusted seed-0 macro is 0.48201782254225 versus Parent 0.464954289379613, a paired change of 0.017063533162637035. Top-1 increased on zaleplon_mpo, deco_hop, drd2_docking, and sitagliptin_mpo, but decreased on median_2, so prefix-local exceptional returns were informative overall but not uniformly across objectives.

Evidence is limited to seed 0 and five 300-call, batch-10 benchmark sessions. Cross-seed stability, behavior when child returns are all tied or observed only once, robustness to nonstationary/noisy rewards, and behavior when a high-return prefix is exhausted or has no chemically local useful siblings remain unestablished.

Report maximum-return backup coverage, the mean positive exploitation lift 0.5 * (maximum - mean), the number of decisions with non-tied mixed-versus-mean scores, and the fraction at which the live choice differs from the Parent counterfactual in favor of a child with a higher maximum return. Parent n-90b1d8983033 has no maximum-return statistic, zero configured best-return lift, and zero such choice displacement; activation requires backup coverage 1.0 and a positive displacement rate once a non-tied opportunity exists.
activation_observables.name: best_return_sensitive_uct_choice_rate

applicability_conditions: Objective rewards must be stationary enough that an observed high return is evidence about a prefix's productive descendants rather than transient noise; maximum-sensitive exploitation can overcommit to noisy outliers.

Useful high-scoring completions must share a still-expandable token prefix with additional reachable molecules, so revisiting that prefix can expose new candidates rather than only an exhausted terminal or a permanently closed invalid leaf.

At least one visited competitive branch must have heterogeneous downstream returns, making its maximum exceed its mean and creating a mixed-versus-mean selection opportunity; the change has no behavioral effect when all child returns are tied or every child is visited only once.

Prefix identity must retain enough chemical locality for an exceptional SMILES completion to inform sibling rollouts; representation aliasing or objectives whose useful chemistry lies on unrelated low-prior prefixes can defeat the mechanism.

The inherited failed-leaf closure must continue to leave enough alternative expandable support to fill every announced batch within the fixed local guard; this intent does not change duplicate handling, tree exhaustion behavior, or any fallback.
Evidence is limited to seed 0: the repaired Parent has no three-seed reliability estimate, so stability of best-return pressure across the independent search seeds remains unestablished.
research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism did not happen if any accepted finite oracle score fails to update the stored maximum on every node of its existing trace, if a logged mixed exploitation value or live argmax cannot be reconstructed exactly from the registered 0.5 maximum/0.5 mean formula and the unchanged UCT terms, or if the live choice never differs from the exact mean-only Parent counterfactual despite at least one competitive decision where the two formulas have non-tied argmaxes. A lower benchmark score after complete maximum backup and positive best-return-driven choice displacement would mean the mechanism activated but its exceptional-return pressure was not useful.
research_intent.implementation_change: Add one maximum-downstream-return statistic to TreeNode and update it, together with the unchanged visit count and return sum, on every node of each existing accepted-proposal backpropagation path. In _select_child, use 0.5 * mean_return + 0.5 * maximum_return as the empirical exploitation value for each visited child, and use the corresponding mixed parent value for the existing unvisited-child fallback; retain the current exploration bonus, recurrent-prior scaling, progressive widening, invalid and pending penalties, jitter draw, dead-leaf closure, expansion, rollout, canonicalization, novelty filters, valid fallbacks, prepared model, RNG seeding, and protocol unchanged. At each competitive selection, reuse the same candidate set, penalties, exploration terms, and jitter values to log the exact mean-only Parent counterfactual beside the live mixed-value choice; diagnostics must not consume RNG or affect selection.
research_intent.mechanism: Preserve the best oracle return observed below every visited prefix and replace mean-only UCT exploitation with a fixed equal mixture of that prefix's maximum and average downstream return, so a rare exceptional completion continues to attract bounded search pressure instead of being erased by later mediocre siblings.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Parent n-90b1d8983033 repaired batch completion but deliberately retained n-ad8b380d9b4e's mean-only reward backup and UCT exploitation. On that inherited search, the observed selected-prefix mean-reward advantage was only 0.0006329631895537376 on deco_hop, 0.005031861523035976 on median_2, and 0.001232419284850641 on sitagliptin_mpo; after the repair enabled full seed-0 sessions, n-90b1d8983033 still finished those objectives at Top-1 values 0.5740228977497039, 0.1848376184037789, and 0.22309417065149867. The limiting behavior is that a prefix's rare exceptional completion loses influence as mediocre downstream returns accumulate in its empirical mean, even though this benchmark rewards the single best terminal molecule.
